v9-43.candidate: He took the people, divided them into three companies, and lay in ambush there. He looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. He rose against them and struck them.

v9-54.candidate: And he called quickly to the young man who bore his armour, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say, ‘A woman killed him.’” And his young man pierced him, and Abimelech died.
